title: Natural
subtitle: 「天然／非人工／有機／天生／自然流露」，究竟是哪一種 natural？

words.meaning: 來自大自然的；天然來源的

words.meaning: 有機的；有機栽培的；有機來源的
words.note: 使用者提供，但屬較窄語義。在食品與農業中，organic 通常指符合特定有機生產標準，而不是所有『天然』食品；在化學中又有另一專門義。
words.example: The farm sells certified organic vegetables.

exercises.original: The shop sells natural vegetables grown without synthetic pesticides and certified under recognised farming standards.
exercises.zh: 這間店出售不用合成農藥種植、並獲認證的有機蔬菜。

options.explanation: certified + farming standards + no synthetic pesticides 明確是 organic，而不只是 broadly natural。

falseSynonyms.zh: organic 在食品／農業中通常涉及特定生產標準；不是所有 natural food 都是 certified organic。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The farm sells certified organic vegetables. The product contains natural flavourings.

falseSynonyms.zh: unprocessed 只說未加工；天然來源的東西也可能經過加工。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Raw nuts are largely unprocessed. Natural rubber can be processed into many products.

falseSynonyms.zh: artificial 是 natural 的常見反義詞，不是近義詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The flowers are artificial. The lake formed naturally.

falseSynonyms.zh: innate 只適合天生能力、傾向或特質；不能形容天然礦物或自然景觀。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She has an innate talent. This is a naturally occurring mineral.

falseSynonyms.zh: normal 表示典型、可預期；natural 還可表示來源於自然或不造作。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON It is normal to feel nervous. The fibre is natural rather than synthetic.

falseSynonyms.zh: spontaneous 強調沒有事先計劃；natural 不一定表示自發。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The applause was spontaneous. The fabric is made from natural fibres.

falseSynonyms.zh: authentic 強調真實、真誠、非造作；它不能取代所有 nature-related senses。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Her reaction seemed authentic. The oil contains natural plant extracts.

falseSynonyms.zh: nature 是名詞；natural 是形容詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON They enjoy spending time in nature. The area has natural beauty.
